Atlanta Home Renovation Services

You're looking for a reliable contractor to handle your home renovation in Atlanta, and you've come to the right place. On this site, you can find information on the services offered by Build Heritage, a licensed and insured Georgia home-services contractor, and get a free, written, and itemized quote for your project.

How it Works for Your Atlanta Home Renovation

Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing, to help you achieve your desired renovation. You can contact them through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org, and they will respond within one business day. They serve the metro Atlanta area, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell.

What You Get and What it Costs

The cost of your Atlanta home renovation will depend on the scope of the project, but you can expect to pay between $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement or $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint. It's also recommended to hold back 10-15% of the quote for potential hidden issues.

FAQ

Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, and roofing & tiles.
